This was the first place we went to when we got to NOLA. I've heard that they have the best gumbo in the area so I decided to order it. I got the chicken andouille gumbo, but I was also able to try the seafood okra gumbo. It was a good portion and had the perfect blend of spice and seasonings. I've never had gumbo in my life, so I'm happy that my first one was from The Gumbo Shop. I also tried the alligator sausage which was flavorful, especially with the sauce it came with. Take me to the Gumbo Shop! Not only is the food amazing, but the ambiance and service here is even more splendid. This is an absolute gem in NOLA. We found ourselves here for our last night at 9pm with no wait at all. Their outdoor area feels like you're dining in a garden --so beautiful and romantic.
